summary: Grayscale Avalanche Staking ETF filed an 8-K reporting an amendment to its trust agreement to implement mandatory distributions of staking rewards. The sponsor amended the agreement with the trustee on August 6, 2026, requiring quarterly or monthly cash distributions of staking proceeds net of fees. This is a routine operational change for an ETF, not a special situation such as a merger, tender offer, or restructuring. The filing includes the amendment as an exhibit and plans a prospectus supplement. No deal terms, premiums, or strategic actions are involved; the filing reflects ordinary fund governance.
